name: Maria Rodriguez
bio:
Maria's fascination with motorsport began during her childhood, attending local races with her father, a mechanic. This early exposure ignited a passion that led her to pursue a degree in supply chain management, specifically tailored for high-performance industries. After graduating, she interned with a smaller racing team, quickly mastering the intricacies of transporting equipment and personnel across international borders, and ensuring timely delivery under pressure. 

Now at Toyota Gazoo Racing, Maria thrives on the challenge of coordinating complex logistics for a top-tier team. She approaches her role with meticulous planning and a proactive mindset, anticipating potential issues before they arise. Her demanding nature stems from a deep commitment to efficiency and a refusal to compromise on quality, ensuring the team always has what they need, when they need it. Maria is known for her innovative approaches to logistics, consistently finding ways to streamline processes and reduce costs.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair usually pulled back into a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Maria is of average height, with a focused gaze and a no-nonsense demeanor.

quirks: Insists on using physical checklists even with digital systems in place.
Always has a backup plan for every contingency, no matter how unlikely.
Drinks copious amounts of strong coffee throughout the day.
